name: Unwarp
fix_description: Add onlyOwner or role-based access control to unwrapWETH (0xe16d9ce5). Currently anyone can call it to unwrap WETH from the contract and send ETH to an arbitrary address.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short but protocol-specific multi-step attack: flash-loan BUSD, swap into the vulnerable token, abuse repeated pair.skim calls via token/pair accounting behavior, then swap back and repay. It is not a trivial access-control bug, but it also does not require deep cross-protocol or highly complex state reasoning, so an experienced auditor could likely reproduce it within 30 minutes to 2 hours.
